rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for moving something gently or forcefully back and forth, with the intensity supplied by context.

example.english: Rock the chair gently so I can wipe it clean.
example.traditional: 你輕輕搖吓張櫈，等我抹乾淨。
example.jyutping: nei5 hing1 hing1 jiu4 haa5 zoeng1 dang3 dang2 ngo5 mut3 gon1 zing6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for natural rock, an outcrop, or a stone thrown at something.

example.english: That rock is so big we can't move it.
example.traditional: 嗰嚿石大到我哋搬唔郁。
example.jyutping: go2 gau6 sek6 daai6 dou3 ngo5 dei6 bun1 m4 juk1

rows.note: Use this specifically for the musical genre rock music.

example.english: I loved listening to rock music when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個最鍾意聽搖滾樂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 teng1 jiu4 gwan2 ngok6

rows.note: Use this when an event or piece of news deeply shocks, disturbs, or greatly affects people.

example.english: This news can rock the whole city.
example.traditional: 呢單新聞可以震撼全城。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 ho2 ji5 zan3 ham6 cyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this for an individual ice cube, including ice served in a drink.

example.english: There’s an ice cube in the iced lemon tea, not a rock.
example.traditional: 杯凍檸茶入面有冰粒，唔係有粒石呀。
example.jyutping: bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4 jap6 min6 jau5 bing1 nap1 m4 hai6 jau5 lap1 sek6 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for playing or performing rock music rather than merely enjoying or praising it.

example.english: We’re going to rock tonight; we’ll be really good!
example.traditional: 我哋今晚玩搖滾，實夠晒勁！
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 waan2 jiu4 gwan2 sat6 gau3 saai3 ging6

rows.note: Use this for the closed-hand move in rock-paper-scissors, commonly in 包剪揼.

example.english: Let's play rock-paper-scissors; the loser buys dinner.
example.traditional: 我哋包剪揼，輸嗰個請食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baau1 zin2 dap6 syu1 go2 go3 ceng2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when someone energizes or livens up a party, venue, or other atmosphere.

example.english: The band made the atmosphere rock as soon as they came on, and everyone immediately stood up.
example.traditional: 個樂隊一出場就炒熱氣氛，成班人即刻企晒起身。
example.jyutping: go3 ngok6 deoi6 jat1 ceot1 coeng4 zau6 caau2 jit6 hei3 fan1 seng4 baan1 jan4 zik1 hak1 kei5 saai3 hei2 san1
